name: Synthetic
short: Privacy-first OpenAI-compatible API for open-source models in private datacenters (no training, no prompt storage); plans $9/$30/$90/mo plus usage-based per-token pricing.

plans.name: Go
plans.notes: Generous limits and reliable access, discounted model rates, web search API, beta models, fast mode.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Larger limits for demanding projects, priority access, one usage reset per month.

plans.name: Big
plans.notes: Biggest limits, higher priority, plus Fast mode (2x speed, 2x rate-limit use) and Infinite mode for background agents (never counts against the rate limit, runs slower).

plans.name: Usage-based
plans.notes: Buy tokens at API rates without subscribing; extra usage on any plan is also billed at API pricing.
